justification: A shows a naturalistic, high-relief carved standing figure in a robe/trousers with hands and drapery folds, above a band of rosettes; B shows flat, schematic painted linear outlines (apparently ships with crew-stroke rows and small stick-like figures) scattered over a rock face. The only correspondence is the very generic presence of humanoid forms and repeated rows of small marks, while the modelling conventions, subject matter and composition are entirely different.
